capabilities: Intercept Markdown rendering to find image elements
Read image files directly from disk and rewrite src as Blob URLs
Bypass the broken app:// protocol for non-ASCII paths and missing codecs
Support png, jpg, gif, webp, svg and bmp formats
extras: README states the underlying defect is an upstream Electron/Chromium bug the Obsidian team cannot fix directly. The plugin is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and bug reports are directed to a separate issues page.
problem: On Linux, Obsidian often fails to display local images because the app:// protocol cannot resolve non-ASCII paths and some Electron builds lack image codecs.
summary: Linux workaround that rewrites image sources to Blob URLs so local images display on Ubuntu, Snap, Flatpak and DEB installs.
